name: Question 9
problem:
Given that $f(x,y,z)=\operatorname{arctan}⁡(x+y+z)$ and

$$
\frac{∂f}{∂x}=\frac{∂f}{∂y}=\frac{∂f}{∂z}=\frac{1}{1+(x+y+z)^{2}},
$$

find the set of values $(x,y,z)$ on which all partial derivatives of $f$ exist.

Question 9
?

Given that f(x,y,z)=arctan⁡(x+y+z) and ∂f∂x=∂f∂y=∂f∂z=11+(x+y+z)2, find the set of values (x,y,z) on which all partial derivatives of f exist.

a
{(x,y,z):x+y+z≠1}
b
{(x,y,z):x+y+z≠0}
c
{(x,y,z):(x+y+z)2>1}
d
{(x,y,z):x,y,z∈(−∞,∞)}
e
{(x,y,z):x+y+z>−1}
